run_extremal_perturbation: run extremal perturbation on a model and input image with a contrastive reward function
get_example_data: get example model and input data for benchmarking attribution methods
get_device: get the best available device for running PyTorch models
plot_example: plot an input image alongside its attribution masks for visualization
use_contrastive_reward: use the contrastive reward function to compare two category IDs during perturbation
